subject: Orbit MAP seed + kickoff — MAP template & first draft
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@orbitai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orbit MAP seed + kickoff — MAP template & first draft

Hi Elena —

Great to meet you last week. Per our conversation, I put together a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) seed and a 3-slide kickoff deck to accelerate a technical eval and decision window for OrbitAI. The goal: get a production-feasible pilot running quickly and capture the acceptance criteria so both teams have a single source of truth.

Files attached / linked below:
- Orbit-MAP-Seed.gdoc (live editable) — draft MAP with owners, milestones, risks
- Orbit-MAP-Deck.slides — 3-slide intro for your execs/engineers

High-level proposal (first pass):
- Week 0: 30-min kickoff (align owners + success criteria)
- Week 1: Tech validation (connect data + sample inference)
- Week 2–4: 21–28 day pilot (throughput + latency + cost profiling)
- Decision: go/no-go + recommended deployment (hosted vs dedicated)

Questions for you before we lock the MAP:
1) Who are the technical owners on your side (names + emails)?
2) Do you need a SOC2/security gate included in week 2?
3) Any mandatory procurement/legal dates we should align to?

Proposed kickoff: Tue Mar 31 10:00 AM PT (30 mins) — happy to send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks — I’ll leave Marissa and Jasmine looped for the MAP template edits and slide polish.

—
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachments: Orbit-MAP-Seed.gdoc (link), Orbit-MAP-Deck.slides (link)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@orbitai.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom@orbitai.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 13:45:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Orbit MAP seed + kickoff — MAP template & first draft

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for sending this over — appreciate the concise MAP. A few quick items from our side:

- Pilot length: can we tighten to a 21-day pilot rather than up to 28? We have a board review window mid-April and prefer earlier completion.
- Security: yes, please add a SOC2/security checkpoint in Week 2 with a short checklist (basic data handling, retention, KMS).
- SLA / procurement: I’ll need a short summary of target SLAs and any data residency notes for our procurement team.

Technical owners: Elena Rossi (elena@orbitai.com), Tom Wu (tom@orbitai.com - infra lead).

We can do the kickoff Tue Mar 31 at 10:00 AM PT — Tom will join as well.

Elena
VP Product | OrbitAI

Mateo / team —

Nice — I reviewed the seed doc and made a few edits in the live GDoc (see 'Security Gate' section and the updated timeline). Summary of changes:

- Added a "Security Gate" checklist (orbit-security-checklist.pdf) with items: KMS integration, minimal PII handling, retention policy, SOC2 artifact request.
- Tightened the pilot to 21 days per Elena's ask and shifted the decision milestone to Day 22 for exec readiness.
- Added owners column (Redwood: Marissa for infra, Mateo for commercial; Orbit: Elena for product, Tom for infra).
- Slide deck: inserted a 1-slide acceptance matrix and a 1-slide integration checklist snapshot.

Suggested ask for kickoff: confirm Orbit attendees and procurement timelines; I can run the security gate live during week 2. Also recommend we include a short pricing appendix in the MAP for expected token costs at projected throughput (helps procurement).

I left in-line comments on the GDoc where we should choose a pilot dataset and whether to whitelist tokenization behaviors.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Elena / Tom —

Thanks — confirmed for Tue Mar 31 10:00 AM PT. I sent a calendar invite and included the Zoom link.

Quick recap of what I updated and what you'll see in the MAP live doc:
- Pilot length: 21 days (Week 1: tech validation; Week 2: pilot execution + security gate; Week 3: final verification + decision)
- Security gate: Marissa will run a checklist during Week 2. Checklist link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OrbitSecurityChecklist (attached as orbit-security-checklist.pdf)
- Acceptance criteria: added an acceptance matrix (latency P95 target, throughput baseline, cost per 1M tokens)
- Commercial note: Jasmine has a short appendix with proposed pilot pricing and optional dedicated trial terms

Next steps for kickoff (Tue):
1) Align owners and agree on pilot dataset and access method
2) Confirm procurement timeline and any required contracts / redlines
3) Set clear success signals and a decision date (Day 22)

I attached the updated seed doc and deck to the calendar invite; you can also open them here:
- MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OrbitMapSeed
- Deck: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1OrbitMapSlides

Looking forward to the call — Mateo

—
Mateo Alvarez
